description: This file defines a PHP trait 'MessageTrait' that provides shared functionality for HTTP message handling, including managing headers, protocol version, and body stream, used by request and response classes within the Nyholm\Psr7 namespace.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the protocol version as a string.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified protocol version.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all message headers as an array.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a specified header.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Returns all header values as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header set.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header added.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified body.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets multiple headers at once, internal method.

methods.name: validateAndTrimHeader
methods.description: Validates and trims header names and values to RFC 7230 compliance.
